//trap: `restore` is ISSUE-ONLY (load_game hands back no completion signal, SerializationCommands.cs:44). The waits below are the completion protocol. Running it while ALREADY in the target phase used to pass on the level being LEFT, before the load started; the `left-old-level` step now asserts the transition instead of asking the caller to compare scenes afterwards.

vars.name: SAVE_NAME
vars.//defaults: TURN and FDEF are SEEDED, not left unset. Their steps only run in tactical, and an unset variable reaches the output as the literal string 'unresolved: ${...} is not set' (Plan.cs:604-608) - a geoscape load used to report that as its answer. Seeding means a skipped step reads as an honest absence, and a real read overwrites it.

TURN.value: n/a - geoscape has no tactical turn

value.name: n/a - geoscape has no faction on turn

steps.//: Refuses up front if no save of that name exists - the command's own 'Could not find savegame' is written on a later frame and could never reach this response.

THE TRANSITION, asserted rather than documented. Loading while ALREADY in the target phase used to pass on the level being left (see //trap): the phase predicate was true before the load even started. This waits for the phase to STOP being the target one first, so the `phase` wait below can only be satisfied by the level that arrived. Turn it off with assertTransition:false when loading from a different phase and the transition is guaranteed anyway.

THE RIGHT PREDICATE. Level.CurrentState == Playing is set at Level.cs:227 and only THEN awaits CallWaiters() at :232, so it lands mid-setup; HasAnyTurnStarted is set at TacticalLevelController.cs:715, one line before NewTurnEvent.

THE NAME IS ON THE DEF, NOT THE FACTION. TacticalFaction is a plain managed object, so its handle DTO carries `h` and `type` and nothing else - `${CUR.value.name}` was unresolvable even on a fully successful tactical load, which is the other half of the long-standing factionOnTurn defect. Only a UnityEngine.Object projects a `name`, and TacticalFactionDef is one.

finally.//: The plan mutates nothing, so cleanup is only the handles it took - and it only ever takes them in tactical. Unguarded, these reached for a variable the geoscape path never set and failed the cleanup block on every geoscape load.
